# FilePos <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
FilePos:Int32 file_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The file handle. |

**Returns:** The position in the file where the next read or write happens, counted in bytes from the start. A newly opened file is at 0.

## Description

_Not documented yet._
